findings: PLACEMENT: corpus/40-dialogue/RI-DLG09-the-parley.md, not 23-stealth-crime/RI-PRL01. (a) S13 is a dialogue seam and its Souls half already lives at dialogue.combat.lockout, area 40-dialogue, critic.dialogue - splitting a SPLIT seam across two areas puts its halves under critics who never read each other. (b) The gate is disposition/reputation/rank/knowledge = RI-DLG04's formulas, same area. (c) RI-CRM02 s3 already PRICES striking a yielded target, so 23-stealth-crime is the consumer, not the owner. (d) 'RI-PRL01' invents an area prefix with no directory under CORPUS-CONTRACT s1/s2.
INPUT: `interact`, HELD. No fifteenth action - HARNESS.md s4 fixes the button set at 14 and RI-JRN03 sA makes it closed. Satisfies Rule A1 (every modality) and A3 (no chord) for free.

FRAMES (ES-PARLEY/1): arm 1-12 f@60 (free cancel), startup 13-42 (30 f@60, guard drops f13), offer 43-54 (12 f@60, `parley` event on f43), recovery 55-102 (48 f@60). Total 102 f@60 = 1700 ms, of which 90 f@60 committed and defenceless. Stamina 20 on f13, re-arms the 42 f@60 regen delay, never refunded. 0 poise, no hyperarmour, no i-frames, 0 m root displacement. Enemy punish window 90 f@60 = 3.1x RI-AI03's 29 f@60 floor and 1.5x its 60 f@60 'big punish'. Sits between RI-CMB02's straight-sword light (74 f@60) and heavy (122 f@60).

GATE LADDER: precedence K(nowledge) > F(action rank) > R(eputation) > G(old, x1.5 in-combat premium per RI-CRM02 s3) > D(isposition, default min 40 = RI-DLG04 Neutral band). First satisfied route fires; the player never browses. fDispWeaponDrawn -5 and fDispAttacking -10 both apply mid-fight, so swinging first makes parley 15 points harder. Refusal: Fight +10, permChange -5, 600 f@60 cooldown, second refusal locks the encounter.

S21 vs S1 COLLISION RULED: a parley's failure is permanent so S21 wants a roll, but S1/AR-1 A1 bans dice inside the fight. Resolution: the die is thrown OUTSIDE the fight (RI-DLG04's rolled persuasion sets disposition); the parley reads the resulting number against an authored threshold. No Math.random() at the resolution frame => A1's own tell is clean. Check P13 enforces it. Flagged in the item's provenance note as needing ratification into ARBITRATION.md - it touches two seams and this item lacks that authority.

PACIFIST-IN-FIGHT lives in RI-DLG09 sD, NOT RI-QST05: different population (encounters vs quest records), different critic (needs the combat harness), and the charter's stalled-correction lesson says the metric must sit next to the thing it measures. Headline floor >= 35%, hard fail < 15% (the audit's own B1 figure), == 0 automatic fail. Segments: speech-capable >= 70%, beast >= 25%, humanoid bosses 100%. Plus PARLEY-COVERAGE 100%, PARLEY-REACHABLE >= 60%, YIELD-RATE >= 70%, EXIT-SPREAD <= 50% (hard fail > 70%, which is what catches 'we shipped fleeing and called it done'), PARLEY-COST 90 f@60 +/-2.

B12 added to CRITIC-DOCTRINE s4.2 between B11 and B13, in B10/B11/B13 form. Five encounter classes x five exits, deaths == 0, re-run class 1 after landing a hit. Tell: zero classes exit non-violently -> AR-2 fail; also PACIFIST-IN-FIGHT < 15% or == 0, any speech:true with no parley block, a YIELD that times out or leaves COMBAT active, EXIT-SPREAD > 70%. B12 and A10 declared a PAIR that must be run together, mirroring B2/B13.

TWO NEW SUBSYSTEM PATHS registered (taxonomy 323 -> 325, holes still 0 because RI-DLG09 judges both): combat.encounter.parley (arb split, area 40-dialogue, critic.combat) and combat.encounter.exit (arb morrowind, area 40-dialogue, critic.combat). grep parley subsystems.json was empty before this pass, which was ND-04's 'no subsystem path, so nothing in INDEX.md routes it to a critic'.

PROPOSED, NOT APPLIED (in RI-DLG09 sF): F.1 RI-JRN02 M-I11 loses its parley carve-out entirely (the parley is an action, not a surface) and HF7 with it, plus a new M-I15 so removing the carve-out does not delete the parley. F.2 RI-QST05 cites PACIFIST-IN-FIGHT as its post-aggro half with an unmeasurable-implies-0 clause mirroring its existing W6 dependency. F.3 ARBITRATION S13 gains audit 01's missing sentence. F.4 HARNESS.md s5 needs a `yield` trace event alongside A-EXP2's `parley`. F.5 HARNESS.md s7 layout should name game/data/combat/encounters/**.json.
